name: Classify Text
description:
Paste any text and instantly see which bucket it belongs in — spam, important, promotional, or personal — with the sorting done right on your device.

**How it works:** You paste some text, a local AI model reads it, and the matching category is shown back to you.

**Setup:**
- Install and enable the awflow browser extension.
- Pick an on-device AI model the first time you run it.

**Good for:** quickly triaging messages, comments, or form entries without sending them to any server.
setup: Install / enable the awflow browser extension.
